description: Source code for a Python binding of an XPU Event class in PyTorch, implementing methods for event creation, recording, waiting, querying, and synchronization, with integration into Python via pybind11.

classes.name: THXPEvent
classes.description: Python binding class for XPU Event, providing methods for event management and synchronization.

methods.name: THXPEvent_pynew
methods.description: Constructor for creating a new XPU Event object with optional timing.

methods.name: THXPEvent_dealloc
methods.description: Destructor for cleaning up the XPU Event object.

methods.name: THXPEvent_get_sycl_event
methods.description: Getter for the SYCL event associated with the XPU event.

methods.name: THXPEvent_get_device
methods.description: Getter for the device associated with the event.

methods.name: THXPEvent_record
methods.description: Records the event on a given stream.

methods.name: THXPEvent_wait
methods.description: Blocks until the event completes on a given stream.

methods.name: THXPEvent_query
methods.description: Checks if the event has completed.

methods.name: THXPEvent_elapsed_time
methods.description: Returns the elapsed time between this event and another.

methods.name: THXPEvent_synchronize
methods.description: Synchronizes the host with the event.

methods.name: THXPEvent_init
methods.description: Initializes the Python module with the XPU Event type.
